101.DiaryAfter:
Lucilla and Liberta brought back a frost-emanating cocoon from the Dimensional Rift, promptly handed it off to me without a second thought.

So now, on top of going out on adventures, I'm helping this sibling duo raise the little thing.
 
Freshly retrieved, the cocoon seemed to shiver from the cold, completely unresponsive to ordinary warmth.

Luckily, today was my day. Under the light of both the sun and the moon, a mysterious sea appeared!

As the master angler I am, I fished up a fleece blanket from the water... Okay, can someone explain why that was in there?

When I brought the fleece blanket over and wrapped the cocoon up snug, the frost on the shell finally melted away as it soaked up the warmth.
 
Ha! A fluffy cloud-like head peeked out! It gazed at me with deep blue eyes...

For something that cute, I'd better give it my all.

103.DiaryAfter:

If I left it alone, I genuinely worried it would tear the whole camp apart!

I raised the star lantern, the one that guides lost souls, and slowly stepped back, holding it out ahead.
